title: Language service: duplicate i0 imports in copied-source TCB
what_breaks: Generic components with host directives and signal inputs show false ngtsc(2339)/(7053) errors in the editor
rationale: Wrong editor diagnostics in one edge case; the CLI build still succeeds
next_check: Alias the core preparation import so it cannot collide with an external i0

evidence_quotes.quote: Expected behavior: no errors should be visible

title: Language service: TCB imports at position zero concatenated without separators
what_breaks: Imports inserted at the start of the copied TCB are joined on one line
rationale: Second defect split from the same report; malformed generated text with no separate user impact shown
next_check: Add a newline separator when inserting imports at position zero

evidence_quotes.quote: imports inserted at position zero are concatenated without separators

title: Router: skip view transitions by default under prefers-reduced-motion
what_breaks: withViewTransitions() animates even when the user asked for reduced motion; a callback workaround exists
rationale: Asks for a new default behaviour, not a defect in documented behaviour
next_check: Product feedback list

evidence_quotes.quote: Make `withViewTransitions()` skip the transition by default

title: Compiler: selectorless lexer loops forever on a lowercase @ attribute
what_breaks: With selectorless enabled, a template like `<div @fadeIn>` hangs the compiler at 100% CPU
rationale: Would block builds, but only on the opt-in selectorless flag on main (v22.0.0-next): pre-release cap
next_check: Fall back to _consumeAttribute() when @ cannot start a directive; add a lexer test

evidence_quotes.quote: the process hangs and has to be killed

title: aria/menu: ngMenuContent is never destroyed after the trigger is focused
what_breaks: Deferred menu rows render on focus and stay alive for the page's life; preserveContent: false has no effect
rationale: Wrong behaviour in one feature with a memory cost for menus repeated per row
next_check: Reset hasBeenInteracted, or base visibility on current focus or active state

evidence_quotes.quote: The content is rendered on the first `focusin` / `keydown`

title: cdk/scrolling: nested viewports and overlays inherit the outer window or element scroller
what_breaks: Inner virtual lists cannot scroll on their own and render items outside their box
rationale: Wrong behaviour in one feature with a documented-in-issue workaround (provide VIRTUAL_SCROLLABLE as null)
next_check: Stop VIRTUAL_SCROLLABLE from leaking past a viewport boundary

evidence_quotes.quote: The inner viewport uses the outer scroller

title: mat-slider: thumb not aligned with cursor on Firefox
what_breaks: While dragging on Firefox, the thumb sits closer to the track centre than the cursor
rationale: Visual misalignment in one browser; the slider still works
next_check: Compare thumb position math in Firefox near the track ends

evidence_quotes.quote: The thumb is closer to the center of the track than the cursor is.

title: aria/grid: composed GridCellWidget does not activate when a child input is focused
what_breaks: A widget applied via hostDirectives stays in CELL mode, so grid navigation is not suspended
rationale: Wrong behaviour in one feature; linked to G109 (same missing marker, different fix)
next_check: Make _getWidget() find composed widgets without the attribute selector

evidence_quotes.quote: The composed widget remains in CELL mode

title: aria/grid: clicking child content does not select a GridCell composed via hostDirectives
what_breaks: Clicking text inside a composed cell moves focus but does not select it
rationale: Wrong behaviour in one feature; linked to G108 (same missing marker, different fix)
next_check: Add a static host attribute for the cell marker used by closest()

evidence_quotes.quote: focus moves, but selection does not change

title: aria/menu: expose MenuTrigger tabindex as a public signal
what_breaks: Wrappers must read the private _pattern to get the trigger's tabindex
rationale: Asks for new public API
next_check: Product feedback list

evidence_quotes.quote: add the equivalent `readonly tabIndex` signal to `MenuTrigger`

title: aria/accordion: NG0950 when a trigger is destroyed before first change detection
what_breaks: Destroying an accordion before init throws NG0950 from ngOnDestroy
rationale: Edge-case teardown error seen in tests; linked to G112 (same pattern, different component)
next_check: Check the fix proposed in the report covers early teardown

evidence_quotes.quote: NG0950: Input "panel" is required but no value is available yet.

title: aria/tree: NG0950 when tree items or groups are destroyed before first change detection
what_breaks: Destroying a tree before init throws NG0950 for the parent or ownedBy inputs
rationale: Edge-case teardown error seen in tests; linked to G111 (same pattern, different component)
next_check: Check the fix proposed in the report covers items and groups

evidence_quotes.quote: NG0950: Input "parent" is required but no value is available yet.

title: mat-select: selected option not announced on first open
what_breaks: Screen readers do not announce "selected" for the initial value the first time the panel opens
rationale: Wrong accessibility output in one feature
next_check: Check aria-selected is set before the first active-descendant update

evidence_quotes.quote: "Selected" is not announce on the very first time the panel opens

title: aria/listbox: Enter during a filter change selects an option that was just removed
what_breaks: A fast Enter can emit and save a value the user never saw
rationale: Wrong value in one feature under timing; the report gives a consumer-side workaround
next_check: Ignore relayed Enter when the active item is no longer in the rendered options

evidence_quotes.quote: the listbox selects the removed option and emits it from `valueChange`

title: cdk/portal: DomPortal content inserted at the end of the component
what_breaks: Portal content appears at the end of the host template instead of at the outlet
rationale: Wrong placement in one feature; only an external commit as repro
next_check: Reproduce from the linked commit in a minimal StackBlitz

evidence_quotes.quote: the DOM node in the portal is inserted at the end of the component's template

title: cdk/portal: allow DomPortal to take detached elements
what_breaks: DomPortal rejects elements without a parent node
rationale: Asks to relax a deliberate guard
next_check: Product feedback list

evidence_quotes.quote: blocks a detached element (one that has no parent node)

title: Paginator: option to hide navigation on a single page
what_breaks: Disabled navigation buttons can only be hidden through private classes
rationale: Asks for a new option
next_check: Product feedback list

evidence_quotes.quote: Hiding the disabled navigation buttons but keeping the useful text

title: aria/accordion: Enter/Space inside a panel toggles the accordion
what_breaks: Keyboard users cannot activate links or buttons inside an expanded panel; Home in an input jumps to the trigger
rationale: Breaks keyboard use of any interactive panel content in production, no simple workaround
next_check: Ignore keydown events that do not come from a trigger

evidence_quotes.quote: The panel collapses, nothing is activated.

title: ClickEventManager: clicks ignored on iOS before 18.2
what_breaks: Clicks without a pointer type are treated as fake, so aria components do not respond on older iOS
rationale: Breaks core interaction for all affected components on an OS still in use, no workaround given
next_check: Treat a missing pointerType as a real click when detail > 0

evidence_quotes.quote: iOS versions older than 18.2 do not have a pointer type

title: matDatepickerInput: invalid text not cleared on control.reset()
what_breaks: After reset to an empty value, invalid date text stays in the input
rationale: Wrong behaviour in one feature; reporter suspects a writeValue change
next_check: Reformat when the last value was invalid even if the value is unchanged

evidence_quotes.quote: Invalid value text remains in the input

title: aria/menu: any DOM change in an open submenu collapses it
what_breaks: A ripple, late icon or `@if` inside an open submenu moves focus up and closes the submenu
rationale: Wrong behaviour in one feature, reproduces every time
next_check: Add an element-wise equal to orderedItems, or read items untracked

evidence_quotes.quote: moves focus back up the menu tree and collapses the open submenu

title: mat-datepicker: overrides mixin ignores period button text size and weight
what_breaks: calendar-period-button text size and weight tokens are overridden by .mat-mdc-button
rationale: Cosmetic theming issue
next_check: Raise specificity of the period button token styles

evidence_quotes.quote: The mixin does not set the size  and weight of the period button

title: material/menu: focus returns to trigger after a menu item opens a dialog with reduced motion
what_breaks: With animations off, focus lands on the trigger behind the dialog backdrop
rationale: Wrong accessibility behaviour in one feature for reduced-motion users
next_check: Skip focus restore on click-close when focus is in another overlay pane

evidence_quotes.quote: focus is moved back to the menu trigger behind the dialog's backdrop

title: material/stepper: styling token for header icon shape
what_breaks: Step icon border-radius is hard coded to 50%
rationale: Asks for a new token
next_check: Product feedback list

evidence_quotes.quote: Currently the value is hard coded to `50%`, which gives rounded icons.

title: mat-datepicker: parse errors not propagated to Signal Forms
what_breaks: Invalid date text gives no parse error in Signal Forms, so empty and invalid look the same
rationale: Missing validation in one feature
next_check: Report parse errors via the Signal Forms parse-error mechanism

evidence_quotes.quote: The date parse errors are not available to the Signal Form.

title: aria/tabs: allow eager rendering of tab content
what_breaks: ngTabContent only works on ng-template, so panels cannot be rendered up front
rationale: Filed as a bug but asks for a new supported mode
next_check: Product feedback list

evidence_quotes.quote: It would be useful to provide a supported way to eagerly instantiate tab panel content
